description: Start here: the circle itself, i.e. its record and rules (get_circle, get_params) plus a page of its members (read API GET /members, or the contract view list_members when no read API is set). Use x207_member_inspect for one member in detail and x207_epoch_report for one epoch. Returns {contract, circleId, circle, params, members, membersSource, warnings}; amounts are strings in the smallest unit (6 decimals). If the members part fails it shows up in `warnings` and the rest is still returned; an unreachable contract RPC is an error.

members_limit.description: Size of the members page, 1 to 200 (default 20); the circle may have more members than this.

members_status.description: Keep only members with this status, e.g. active, suspended or exiting. Read API only; ignored on the contract fallback.
